ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-11-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Cause call for petition for name change.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: Marjorie Schwartz-Scott,
CSR: Deborah Neville
Petitioner: Karina Hernandez for minor: Carlos Jovani Aleman Hernandez
Petitioner was sworn and examined.
The court grants decree changing minor's name to: Carlos Jovani Hernandez
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-11-2004 Reset To Mar-11-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Deborah Neville.
Petitioner, Karina Hernandez present in pro per for the minor: Carlos Jovani Aleman Hernandez, was sworn and examined. No opposition.
Petitioner failed to provide Proof Of Publication, but she is able to show proof to the court.
The Court continued this matter to Mar. 11, 2004 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218 for proof of Publication.
